_recommended_fill_model.per_share_cost_bps: interpolate cm[sym][phase]['table'] at x = clip/L (vs the book mid; book mid != consensus, see report)
_recommended_fill_model.phase_choice: open 0-3 s: do not trade; h1_entry 50-58; h1_exit 72-80; s3_start 80-120; storm 120-540; after 540-780
_recommended_fill_model.followon: add cm[sym]['followon_clip']['penalty_2s_bps'] to each further same-side clip within ~8 s of the previous one
_recommended_fill_model.permanent_impact: shift the reference mid by cm[sym]['permanent_impact_bps_per_L']['storm_10s'] * (net signed shares / L)
